observation: SessionCompaction.result exists in @opencode/plugin 2.3.0 types (packages/plugin/src/effect/session.ts:53-55) with comment 'Set to use this compaction and skip the model request.' Server honors it in packages/core/src/session/compaction.ts:635 deliver(): if (prepared.event.result) return fromHook(); fromHook (873-885) builds Result {text: supplied.summary, native, metadata} with spend() billing only, no llm.stream call. So setting result DOES skip the model request on this base.

Tail loss is metadata, not host bug. Hook-supplied result passes metadata through (compaction.ts:879-883, publish 928-940 stores metadata; history rebuilds tail from metadata.keepID in history.ts:254-279, projector.ts:236-247). Prior live finding (v2.0.22 impl ses-impl-12..41: result replaces view history with note, tail dropped) matches supplying {summary} without keepID. VCC port must supply metadata.keepID pointing at first kept message ID to preserve tail; runtime re-probe still required (window-filling probe deferred per PROBE Do-not).

No deterministic VCC-style plugin exists for OpenCode. npm search 2026-11-19: dsh-compaction-vcc@0.7.4 (DSH only), @sting8k/pi-vcc@0.11.2 (pi agent, algorithmic no-LLM), opencode-side plugins are all model-driven or auxiliary: @tarquinen/opencode-dcp (compress tool + pruning, model decides), @madsoftwaredev/opencode-compaction-model (dedicated compaction model), @esuyo/esuyo-opencode-compaction (fixed 256k), @cesarus777/opencode-cgp (native policy/monitor), opencode-compaction-guard (tool_use/tool_result repair), opencode-compaction-meter (thrash observability). VCC port would be first LLM-free deterministic engine on OpenCode if keepID path verifies at runtime.
